failures.observed: MySqlConnector.MySqlException: You have an error in your SQL syntax ... near '_utf8mb4 X'2c')
failures.cause: The GROUP_CONCAT delimiter was recorded as an ordinary value occurrence and the MySQL specialization lowered its placeholder to a charset-introduced hex expression (src/nextorm.core/DataContext/Cache/DbPreparedQueryCommand.cs:407); MySQL's SEPARATOR grammar accepts a string token, not an expression, so the statement no longer parses.

failures.observed: System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException: The recorded length 4 cannot shrink to 0. (Parameter 'emittedLength')
failures.cause: The ClickHouse array-function translator renders an argument into the shared builder and then rewinds the builder (ClickHouseNativeFunctionTranslator.Capture, builder.Length = start), while the D4 template recorder has already advanced past that fragment; the next AdvanceTo computes a smaller absolute length and the recorder throws.

failures.observed: SQL now renders E'{"k\'ey":"it\'s"}' (backslash-escaped apostrophes); the assertion expects doubled apostrophes.
failures.note: row.Json and row.Text pass; only the SQL-shape assertion is stale. PostgreSQL value/JSON literals are declared as explicit E'...' with backslash escapes (src/nextorm.core/Visitors/SqlStringLiteralPolicy.cs:75, RenderPostgres) and the D7 shape test pins that form (tests/nextorm.postgres.tests/SqlGeneration/InlineStringLiteralSqlGenerationTests.cs InlineApostrophe_ShouldDoubleTheEmbeddedQuote asserts E'it\'s (a) test').

failures.observed: Expected SQL to contain "digest(@norm_p0, 'sha256')" but the statement renders digest(@norm_p0, E'sha256').
failures.note: Only the exact-spelling assertion at line 518 fails; the looser 'sha256' assertions at lines 508/516 still pass. E'sha256' is the declared PostgreSQL value spelling.

SQL Server string literals are declared as N'...' (src/nextorm.core/Visitors/SqlStringLiteralPolicy.cs:73); datalength(N'abc') is 6 bytes, so the provider-native bit_length is 48. Nothing else changed.

Consequence of the declared N'...' spelling: COMPRESS receives an nvarchar and DECOMPRESS returns its UTF-16 bytes. The round-trip is still exact for the transport; the expected byte array must follow the N-literal representation.

ExpressionPlanEqualityComparer.cs is untouched on this branch (git log 52297fa8..HEAD for the file is empty); the failure occurs while hashing a sorting expression before any literal rendering, and no frame in the stack belongs to a changed file.
